title: Ru biển đêm
about: Round x6, for sleep (style ngu-ngon), as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm cho tôi nhiều bài nữa, phù hợp cho các người nghe có thể nghe để ngủ"): the sea at night far off, soft swells every few seconds like slow breathing, a dark pad and deep sub, a felt piano barely touched rising and falling on the chords. A minor at 50 bpm, about six minutes, even throughout. Nothing sudden: no thunder, heartbeat or struck bells. An original piece.
